text:
lina: Quick kickoff for the Harpoon pilot — short PLG test: free credits + compact prompt template pack + 25-min webinar. Hypothesis: bundled onboarding will increase 7-day DAU retention by ~8-12%. Need routing + messaging decisions today.

marc: Thumbs up. Webinar date? If we do Tue 11am PT, we can push a reminder series. I'll draft 2 email sequences.

devon: Proposal on split: 60% credits only, 40% credits + promptpack + webinar. Track cohorted metrics. Keep cohort sizes ~1k each if possible.

priya: For infra, estimate concurrent viewers: ~120 if conversion is 12% from invites. ops-bot: can we auto-scale to handle 300 concurrent for safety?

ops-bot: autoscale template ready. Reserving an extra node group for the day-of surge. Please confirm expected peak by EOD. :gear:

ben: Quick routing pseudo:
```
segment: new_signup_0to3d
trigger: first_successful_call
actions:
  - credit_grant: 75
  - enroll_promptpack: harpoon-starter-v2
  - enroll_email_series: harpoon-webinar-reminders
  - flag_for_metric: launch_harpoon_group
metrics: d1_calls, promptpack_open_rate, day7_retention
```
We should also tag events with experiment_id so Console can filter.

marc: Messaging angle: two variants. A: "Build an AI assistant in 15 minutes" (use-case). B: "Get ready-made prompt templates + live demo" (product). We'll A/B subject lines and hero CTAs.

lina: Growth-bot, can you surface baseline day7 retention + avg token spend for last 30 days? Need to model cost-per-activated-user.

growth-bot: Baseline pulled. cohort_day7_avg: 17.6%, avg_tokens_first_week: 2.1k, est_unit_cost_per_activation: $5.50. CSV uploaded to #marketing-assets/harpoon_baseline.csv.

devon: Measurement plan: primary = % lift in day7 retention; secondary = promptpack adoption (users who call prompt template >3 times) and webinar watch rate. Create dashboard named "harpoon_pilot".

priya: CS follow-up plan: short in-product message + 2-email drip for webinar attendees with quick wins and 3 example prompts to copy. Hoping to boost reuse.

lina: Action list:
- @marc: email sequences + 3 subject lines + CTAs (EOD)
- @ben: add experiment_id tagging & routing rule in Console (tomorrow AM)
- @priya: CS drip content outline + examples (tomorrow)
- @ops-bot: confirm reserve capacity and scaling plan (EOD)
- @growth-bot: refresh baseline after seed launch and attach cohort CSVs

marc: One more question: credit amount — 75 credits default. If we want to test sensitivity we can do 50 vs 100 but prefer uniform for first run to keep analysis simple.

lina: Agree uniform. We'll use 75.

ben: I'll instrument the events with experiment tags and create the dashboard filters. ETA tomorrow 9am.

lina: Sounds good. I'll post a short summary for execs once the dashboard exists. :white_check_mark:
